title: Sign range under coordinate fixing
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a type, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f:(\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to\Omega)\to\mathbb R$ take values only in $\{-1,1\}$. For every coordinate $j\in\mathrm{Fin}\,n$ and every $\omega\in\Omega$, the function obtained by replacing the $j$th input coordinate by $\omega$ before evaluating $f$ also takes values only in $\{-1,1\}$.
